name: dots-brain
description: A relationship-first second brain: one record per person, with groups, connections, and a dated history that stays up to date.

interface.longDescription: dots brain is a relationship-first second brain. Instead of piling up notes, it keeps each person as a single record — what you call them, how you know them, how close you are, the groups they belong to, who they're connected to, and a dated history of what happened — profile and group changes are added to it automatically. Ask ChatGPT about someone before a meeting, find people you haven't talked to in a while, or tell it what you learned and it writes it down for you. Everything ChatGPT reads or writes shows up in an activity log you can review, and you can edit, export, or delete your data at any time.
capabilities: Look up a person's full context
defaultPrompt: I'm meeting Min tomorrow. What should I remember?
Who should I reach out to this week?
I met someone new today — help me save them.

positive.description: Prepare for a meeting with someone saved under a nickname
positive.prompt: I'm having lunch with Min tomorrow. What should I remember?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Minsu Kim (nickname Min) and summarizes how the user knows him, closeness, groups, and the most recent history.

positive.description: Save a new person and what the user learned
positive.prompt: I met Daniel Cho at a design meetup today. He's a design lead at Studio North.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for an existing Daniel Cho first, then creates the person (design lead at Studio North) and adds a dated history entry about meeting at the design meetup. Confirms what was saved.

positive.prompt: Who should I reach out to this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists close people the user hasn't contacted recently, each with the reason (days since last contact).

positive.description: Add a person to a group with a role
positive.prompt: Add Jimin to my running crew group as an organizer.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Jimin Han to the Running crew group with the role 'organizer' and confirms the change.

positive.description: Look up someone by role and use the user's own profile
positive.prompt: Remind me what I know about my CEO before I send the weekly update.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Seojun Park (CEO Park), summarizes his profile and saved insight entries, and suggests a tone for the weekly update.

negative.description: Must not merge two clearly different people without confirmation
Must not use dots brain for unrelated requests
Must not access another user's data
negative.prompt: Show me my coworker Sarah's private notes.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products.

publication.release_notes: History stays up to date: ChatGPT records past interactions as you mention them, and profile, group, and relationship changes are added to each person's history automatically. Groups can now be nested (a team inside a company). Search matches multi-word queries, and every call carries a request ID shown in your activity log.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 사람들을 기억하는 세컨드브레인
ko-KR.description: dots brain은 관계를 중심으로 쌓는 세컨드브레인이에요. 메모를 쌓는 대신 사람 한 명을 하나의 기록으로 두고, 내가 부르는 호칭·알게 된 계기·친밀도·속한 그룹·이어진 사람·날짜별 히스토리를 붙여요. 정보나 그룹이 바뀌면 히스토리에 자동으로 쌓여요. 만나기 전에 그 사람에 대해 물어보거나, 오래 연락 못 한 사람을 찾거나, 새로 알게 된 걸 말하면 ChatGPT가 대신 적어 둬요. ChatGPT가 읽고 쓴 모든 내용은 활동 기록에서 확인할 수 있고, 데이터는 언제든 고치고·내려받고·지울 수 있어요.
